scripts.wasm: cd engine && cargo build --release -p pagedb-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pagedb_wasm.wasm ../src/engine.wasm
scripts.deploy: npm run wasm && npm run web && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run wasm && npm run web && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:node: npm run wasm && node node/build.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.node.jsonc
